notes: «حدثني عمي القاسم بن يحيى»: «عمي» with a name is one link named by the name alone (rule 7)
«رواه سعيد عن مالك» is a second isnad after the saying (rule 4): its own group; no compiler's shaykh is written for it
«وقال عمر بن حمزة» and «وقال أبو اليمان» open further isnads; «بهذا» closes the third as a back_reference to its wording
«أن أبا هريرة، قال قال رسول الله»: Abu Hurayra is the one who speaks the saying, so he is the last link
